release_notes: Build 85 adds Match archive to Quiz History. It scans the configured Z: archive and reconnects missing Quiz History paths to existing quiz folders without moving, renaming, overwriting or deleting files.
Archive matching reuses Factburst's quiz/video matching rules, requires a unique one-to-one match, and leaves ambiguous or unmatched entries unchanged for review.
The matcher previews archive-folder, already-linked, existing-local-path, ready, ambiguous and unmatched counts before any database paths are updated.
Build 84 adds Archive selected to Quiz History so an already-completed quiz can be safely moved from the local Projects folder to the configured archive without forcing a re-upload.
Build 83 changes the Full and Marathon quiz defaults from 8 seconds to 5 seconds per question; Shorts remains at 3 seconds.
Completed quiz projects can be archived automatically after all required uploads finish using copy, verification, Quiz History path update and local cleanup.
NAS archiving is collision-safe: existing backup folders are preserved and a unique archive destination is used instead of overwriting them.
Build 82 fixes the Questions importer UI and Build 81 adds Open Trivia DB JSON importing with preview, category mapping and duplicate handling.
